comparison: Five-arm A/B on ARC-AGI-3 ls20: reactive baseline vs EWM text-only vs EWM vision (qwen35b-arc, PRE-fix harness) vs EWM vision (qwen-coding, FIXED probe-first harness) vs EWM graph-native multi-step synthesis (qwen-coding, config.graph_synthesis: ANALYZE->PLAN->EDIT->FINAL state machine, first run on a real game).
harness_note: Arms 1-3 ran on the PRE-fix harness where a program could be adopted vacuously (validated against zero transitions at cold start). Arm 4 runs on the FIXED harness (probe-first seeding: min_probe_transitions=4, adoption requires validate() pass on a NON-EMPTY suite; plus repair caps and a live pass-rate floor 0.5/last-20 -> reactive fallback). Adoption semantics therefore DIFFER between arm 3 and arm 4: arm 3's program_adopted:true was vacuous; arm 4's program_adopted:false means 4 real synthesis attempts each failed validation against observed transitions and the harness correctly refused adoption. Arm 6 (ewm_warmstart_kb_seeded_orient): seeded the 12/13 dev-time ls20 program into the live KB and added ORIENT partial-adoption + live KB wiring; warm start did NOT engage — Run 12's driver predated the kb wiring fix (kb=None, ORIENT never queried), and independently the daemon's 2000-char note cap + 200-char /search summary truncate the program below a compiling round-trip. The seeded program itself is live-valid: 12/13 on Run 12's own transitions, 1.000 changed-cells accuracy, partial-adopts with a 22-cell mask (masked 13/13).

ewm_vision_qwen35b_arc_prefix.note_adoption: VACUOUS: adopted against zero transitions at cold start (pre-fix rule), then mispredicted all 80 observed transitions (divergences=80, empirical pass rate 0.0).

ewm_vision_qwen_coding_fixed.harness: FIXED (probe-first seeding + repair caps + live pass-rate floor). program_adopted here is NOT comparable to arm 3: false means candidates were tested against a real non-empty suite and all failed validation.
ewm_vision_qwen_coding_fixed.live_pass_rate: 1.0 (VACUOUS -- window only scores against an adopted program; none was adopted, so the empty-window default 1.0 is reported)
ewm_vision_qwen_coding_fixed.best_pass_rate: no candidate program passed validate() on the seeded suite (0/4 synthesis attempts adopted)
ewm_vision_qwen_coding_fixed.note_divergences: field counts reactive_turns, not model divergences: 80 actions = 4 probe-seeding actions + 76 reactive fallback turns; zero expect-mismatches because no program was ever executed

ewm_graph_synthesis_qwen_coding.agent: EwmAgent + graph-native multi-step synthesis (synth_graph.SynthSession: ANALYZE->PLAN->EDIT chain->FINAL); the first graph-native multi-step synthesis on a real game (ls20 run 8)
ewm_graph_synthesis_qwen_coding.model: qwen-coding:latest (qwen35moe 36B, vision-capable, ollama) as BOTH gameplay and synthesis
ewm_graph_synthesis_qwen_coding.harness: FIXED (probe-first seeding + repair caps + live pass-rate floor), with config.graph_synthesis=True: SYNTHESIZE runs the graph-native ANALYZE->PLAN->EDIT->FINAL state machine over deltas.summarize_suite object-level deltas. Adoption unchanged: FINAL full-suite validate must pass on a non-empty suite.
ewm_graph_synthesis_qwen_coding.note: Graph degradation: the live daemon did not serve /task/context or /overlay/note (404) and /sync intermittently timed out; graph ops degraded to best-effort no-graph, so the multi-step state machine ran without wired task nodes. A failed session with clean per-change telemetry is a valid result.
ewm_graph_synthesis_qwen_coding.note_synthesis_attempts: summary synthesis_attempts field was 0 (live binary predated the per-cycle counter). Ground truth: ~11 graph-native synthesis SESSIONS producing 27 EDIT candidates; all 27 rejected at load (24 numpy imports, 3 truncated). 0 adopted.

ewm_warmstart_kb_seeded_orient.orient_adopted_reason: Two independent breaks, both UPSTREAM of validation. (1) Run 12's driver built the agent with kb=None (pre-fix live_run), so _kb_search('ORIENT') returned [] without any HTTP call — ORIENT never queried the KB at all; modes_visited confirms no ORIENT adoption (RECOVER+SYNTHESIZE only). Fixed on this branch: live_run now wires WriteGate(KbClient(ZONOID_DAEMON_URL, workspace, task_key)). (2) Even with the KB wired, the daemon caps a stored note body at 2000 chars (overlay.js addNoteNode slice(0,2000)) and GET /search returns only a 200-char summary snippet (memory-search.js; full_content=true caps content at 1200 chars), so the 3272-char ls20 program (2010 chars minified) cannot round-trip: the seeded note IS retrieved by the exact ORIENT query 'game ls20 world model program' and passes _is_game_scoped, but its returned body is truncated below a compiling program, so _program_source_from_hit finds no loadable source. NOT the break: retrieval ranking, parsing, live-board mismatch, validation, or the changed-cells floor — the seeded program validates 12/13 on Run 12's OWN live transition suite, scores 1.000 changed-cells accuracy (floor 0.6), masks 22 cells (0.54% of board, cap 15%), and _try_partial_adopt succeeds (masked 13/13). Had retrieval delivered the program bytes, the agent would have adopted it on the live board.

ewm_warmstart_native_note_get_run13.orient_adopted_reason: ORIENT ADOPTED via the NATIVE full-body note read (orient_diagnosis='adopted whole (native)'). This is the Run-13 result of three converging fixes over Run 12's double break: (1) DAEMON: lib/note-source-cluster.js chunkText no longer trims chunk-leading indentation at write time -- it splits the cleaned evidence on the exact '\n\n' separator reassembleNoteBody rejoins with and never trims a segment, so an indented program round-trips byte-exact and compiles (verified live: get_note_full on the reseeded note returns the ceiling program byte-identical to input, python3-compiles). (2) HARNESS native read: kb_protocol.KbClient.get_note_full(key) hits GET /note/get?key&workspace&full=1, the daemon's server-side source-cluster reassembly, and agent._orient now prefers that native path FIRST (index-note key from the ORIENT keyed search -> get_note_full -> extract fenced/marked source -> load/validate/partial-adopt), falling back to the flagged chunk scheme then the legacy inline body. (3) HARNESS artifact-key derivation: the ORIENT keyed /search surfaces the 'knowledge:source_doc:note-<id> ... evidence' CLUSTER ARTIFACT (the index note's own summary is compacted to a stub at write time, so the evidence node outranks it on the program query); /note/get only resolves note: keys, so _hit_key derives the parent note:<id> from the artifact before the read -- otherwise get_note_full 404s (observed live in an intermediate run before this fix landed). Plus a live-KbClient timeout bump (20s->60s) so an ORIENT /search or /note/get under concurrent daemon-drain load does not time out and silently drop the warm-start. RESULT: ORIENT recalled and adopted the 12/13 ceiling program whole, straight from the KB, with synthesis_attempts=0.
ewm_warmstart_native_note_get_run13.why_no_level_cleared: NO level cleared (levels_completed=0, won=false, stop_reason=budget). The warm-start program was adopted WHOLE, but on THIS live ls20 instance it diverged heavily: live_pass_rate=0.05 over suite_size=35, divergences=31. The dev-time ceiling program (12/13 on its own captured transition suite) does not generalize to this game seed's live dynamics, so EXECUTE kept mispredicting and the loop routed to SYNTHESIZE without producing a level solve before the 1500s budget expired (34 actions, no level boundary crossed). The pillar-5 warm-start MECHANISM is now proven end-to-end (native adopt fired); the adopted program's live accuracy is the remaining bottleneck, not retrieval.
ewm_warmstart_native_note_get_run13.delta_vs_run12: Run 12 orient_adopted=false (KB unwired + program truncated below a compiling round-trip). Run 13 orient_adopted=true 'adopted whole (native)': the daemon chunkText indentation fix + native /note/get read + cluster-artifact parent-key derivation make the 3272-byte program round-trip byte-exact and adopt. Warm-start retrieval is SOLVED; the adopted program's live-instance accuracy (0.05 pass rate, 31 divergences) is the remaining bottleneck, and no level cleared before the time budget.

ewm_warmstart_trust_probes_repair_run14.agent: EwmAgent warm-start (native /note/get ORIENT) + Run-14 hypothesis-trust revalidation + live-divergence REPAIR engagement
ewm_warmstart_trust_probes_repair_run14.orient_adopted_reason: ORIENT recalled the ls20 ceiling program via native /note/get and adopted it WHOLE, but this run gates whole adoption behind the Run-14 hypothesis-trust revalidation: the recalled program was re-measured on the 5 fresh probe transitions through the CHANGED-cells floor (orient_revalidation={probes:5, pass_rate:1.0, adopted_as:'whole'}) — it predicted the probe object-moves perfectly, so it earned whole adoption rather than being trusted on a vacuous UNKNOWN skip. The Run-13 pathology (adopted-whole then 31 divergences with 0 repairs) does NOT recur: repair_attempts=3 (up from 0), live_pass_rate=0.93 (up from 0.05).
ewm_warmstart_trust_probes_repair_run14.why_no_level_cleared: NO level cleared (levels_completed=0, won=false, stop_reason=budget). Unlike Run-13, the recalled program's live divergences DID route into REPAIR (repair_attempts=3): the loop detected the mispredicted live transitions and re-entered the REPAIR path with the failing transition + recalled source. All 3 REPAIR candidates authored by qwen-coding failed the 19-transition suite (0/19 each) — the model could not synthesize the missing wall/collision blocking within the wall-clock budget — so the recalled program held at live_pass_rate 0.93. The trust + repair-engagement mechanisms work; the remaining gap is REPAIR candidate quality, not repair engagement.

delta_vs_run13.repair_attempts: 0 -> 3 (REPAIR now engages on a KB-adopted program's live divergence)

ewm_warmstart_run16_goal_discovery_fast_.agent: EwmAgent warm-start (Run 16, goal-discovery frontier + model-trusted fast path)
ewm_warmstart_run16_goal_discovery_fast_.note: First launch crashed 17 min in on an uncaught LLM-timeout in REPAIR (fixed: _decide degrades on LlmError); relaunch ran to full budget. Frontier exploration + fast path engaged live; no level boundary observed, is_win never re-derived, no level clear.

ewm_warmstart_run17_orient_retry_llm_fre.agent: EwmAgent warm-start (Run 17, ORIENT retry on daemon timeouts + LLM-free exploration executor)
ewm_warmstart_run17_orient_retry_llm_fre.note: ORIENT retry delivered: 2 daemon-timeout retries then whole adoption (orient_kb_attempts=3), synthesis_attempts 1 -> 0 — the run-16 wasted synthesis cycle is gone. But the reclaimed budget went to 6 failed REPAIR decides off 3 transient divergences (18/18 repair extract failures across runs 15-17), so llm_calls_per_action stayed 2.0 (target <0.2) and the LLM-free exploration executor sustained only 2 frontier batches. No boundary, no level clear. Next lever: stop re-entering REPAIR on transient divergences while the recalled program's live pass-rate is 1.0.

ewm_warmstart_run18_divergence_tolerance.agent: EwmAgent + ORIENT warm-start + LLM-free exploration executor + Run-18 divergence-tolerance policy (classify transient -> auto-extend mask, no trust drop, no repair; gate repair on rolling window; runtime repair sanity cap per divergence signature)
ewm_warmstart_run18_divergence_tolerance.harness: FIXED (probe-first seeding + repair caps + live pass-rate floor + native note_get warm start + goal discovery/fast path + ORIENT retry + LLM-free frontier executor), with config.divergence_tolerance=True: transient divergences confined to the mask are tolerated (mask auto-extended within mask_cap), REPAIR gated on repair_trigger_pass_rate=0.85, and a runtime sanity cap (repair_sanity_cap=2) halts identical extract/compile repair loops per divergence signature. graph_synthesis=True.
ewm_warmstart_run18_divergence_tolerance.note: Run 18 divergence-tolerance policy: on an expect-mismatch the loop first CLASSIFIES the divergence — if the mispredicted cells are confined to (or 8-neighbour-adjacent to) a partial adoption's known-unmodelable mask AND the model is proven healthy (prior live window >= repair_trigger_pass_rate 0.85), it AUTO-EXTENDS the mask (respecting mask_cap), counts a transient tolerated, and CONTINUES with NO trust drop and NO repair. REPAIR now engages only once the rolling window degrades below 0.85; a runtime sanity cap halts repairing a divergence signature after 2 consecutive extract/compile failures (the qwen 0-for-18 loop). Telemetry: transients_tolerated=None, mask_auto_extensions=None, repair_skips=None. Target: kill the futile REPAIR decides that dropped fast-path trust and strangled the LLM-free explorer at 2 batches/20 actions in run 17.
ewm_warmstart_run18_divergence_tolerance.telemetry_caveat: This run executed on the driver BEFORE the transients_tolerated/mask_auto_extensions/repair_skips fields were propagated into the live_run summary, so those top-level fields were not emitted. transients_tolerated=3 is DERIVED (divergences=3 with repair_attempts=0 -> every divergence was tolerated, none repaired). The driver now propagates all three; future runs surface them natively. Adoption was WHOLE (native note_get), not a partial mask adoption, so tolerance here fired via the REPAIR-GATING path (window held at 1.0), not mask auto-extension.

ewm_warmstart_run19_interaction_discover.agent: EwmAgent + ORIENT warm-start + LLM-free exploration executor + divergence tolerance + Run-19 INTERACTION DISCOVERY (on movement-frontier exhaustion with no boundary: probe untried non-movement actions adjacent to each distinct object class, cheapest-first, deduped, effect-diffed against the auto-changing region, discoveries recorded as game-scoped interaction notes)
ewm_warmstart_run19_interaction_discover.harness: FIXED harness through run-18, plus config.interaction_discovery=True (coverage_plateau_exhaust=2, max_interaction_probes_per_turn=6): frontier exhaustion is now ALSO declared when real coverage plateaus for 2 consecutive batches, routing to interaction probing instead of a blind reactive probe. graph_synthesis=True.
ewm_warmstart_run19_interaction_discover.note: Interaction discovery landed and is test-proven (toy switch game solved end-to-end) but did NOT engage live: (1) the within-run coverage plateau (2 zero-coverage batches) never fired — 80 actions were consumed re-sweeping the same 5% the previous runs covered, because coverage resets per run; (2) decisively, ls20 exposes ONLY ACTION1-4, all translations — the non-movement probe vocabulary is EMPTY on this game, so the mode as specified (SPACE-class actions at object contexts) cannot fire on ls20 at all. The win interaction must be contact/positional. Next levers: cross-run coverage persistence (plateau fires within one budget) + BUMP probes (movement actions fired INTO each adjacent blocked object class).

delta.actions_taken: baseline 51, text-only 70, vision pre-fix 80, vision fixed 80 (each hit its own action/wall cap)
delta.program_adopted: only arm 3 adopted -- and vacuously; arm 4's non-adoption is the fixed harness correctly refusing 4 non-validating candidates, which is the intended behavior, not a regression

verdict: TRUTHFUL FOUR-ARM FAILED A/B. All four arms completed 0 of 7 ls20 levels. Arm 4 (qwen-coding, both roles, vision on, FIXED probe-first harness) is the first arm where the world-model machinery behaved fully honestly end-to-end: probe seeding banked 4 real transitions before any synthesis, SYNTHESIZE engaged 4 times against a non-empty suite that grew to 80 transitions, and every candidate program failed validate() -- so the harness refused adoption and fell back to reactive play (76 reactive turns), exactly as designed. Contrast with arm 3, where the pre-fix harness adopted a program against zero evidence and then watched it miss all 80 transitions. Net: the fix converted 'confidently wrong world model' into 'no world model, honest fallback' -- same level score, better epistemics. The remaining bottleneck is unchanged and now cleanly isolated: neither local 35B-class model can yet author a Python program that reproduces real ls20 dynamics, whether validated before (arm 4) or after (arm 3) adoption. Telemetry caveats recorded on arm 4: live_pass_rate=1.0 is the vacuous empty-window default (no adopted program to score), and divergences=76 counts reactive turns, not expect-mismatches.
pair_recommendation: For the Kaggle two-local-model pair: use qwen-coding:latest as the SYNTHESIS model and qwen35b-arc:latest as the GAMEPLAY (+vision) model. Rationale, stated with its evidential limits: qwen-coding is the only model observed emitting candidate programs under the fixed harness's real validation gate (4 attempts, parseable fenced programs, no thinking-drain with reasoning_effort:none), making it the better-evidenced synthesis half even though none of its candidates validated yet; qwen35b-arc showed the sharper multimodal grounding in sanity checks (named the exact changed cell+color on the composite, where qwen-coding was off-by-one on a 3x3), making it the better-evidenced gameplay/vision half. CAVEAT: no arm has run qwen35b-arc on the fixed harness, and no arm has cleared a level, so this recommendation ranks failure modes rather than successes; a qwen35b-arc-synthesis arm on the fixed harness would be the decisive missing data point.
